apk.notes: Settings → Delete My Account. A shop's only owner can save a copy of its inventory and transactions first (install this version of the app for that).

web.notes: Deckbox: check items to print only those (nothing checked prints the whole list). Price Tag is picked to start with. Printing more than 25 labels at once asks first.
